newsitem.title: USA: Dell hires Compaq VP to head server unit.
newsitem.headline: Dell hires Compaq VP to head server unit.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said on Wednesday it hired Compaq Computer Corp vice president Michael Lambert as senior vice president of the server unit.
Lambert, 49, was most recently vice president of marketing at Compaq, Dell said.

He will have responsibility for developing a worldwide server business that integrated marketing, field network consultants and systems engineers, as well as manufacturing, technology and services relationships, Dell said. He will report to the office of the chairman, composed of Michael S. Dell, chairman and chief executive officer, and Morton L. Topfer, vice chairman, the company said.
